projectsText: The projects below showcase my experience and interests in software development. Every project was designed and developed by me using a variety of modern frontend and backend technologies.
aboutText: I am an Angular Developer working at the Hungarian National Tax and Customs Administration, where I contribute to the development of enterprise web applications. My primary technologies are Angular, TypeScript and Node.js, while I also have experience with React, Python and Java through personal and academic projects. Outside of work I enjoy learning new technologies and building my own applications, focusing on modern web development practices and cloud-based solutions. Besides software development, trail running is my biggest passion. It has taught me perseverance, problem solving and continuous improvement—qualities that I also bring into my daily work as a developer.
